description:
In this challenge We are trying to devise a way to integrate the presentation of Mars regions to space agencies and astronauts 

And we use Ai field to support our project
summary: The project develops the Mars 3D Mission Explorer, an integrated platform that brings together Mars surface maps, scientific datasets, and geographic information into a single, organized interface. It addresses key challenges such as data fragmentation, data inconsistency, environmental complexity, route assessment, decision-making gaps, and the theory-to-experience gap. Additionally, it integrates First-Person View (POV) and  Virtual reality (VR) features to transform complex scientific data into an intuitive, interactive visual experience.
details:
Function and Operation: Provides an interactive 3D map that allows users to explore Martian terrain, elevations, and geological formations from multiple perspectives. Integrates scientific datasets, including elevation measurements, geological characteristics, and environmental indicators. Enables users to explore and compare alternative routes based on distance, estimated travel time, terrain conditions, and traversal difficulty.

Benefits and Impact: Helps astronauts understand the Martian environment and prepare for potential conditions before arrival. Improves risk assessment and mission planning by balancing crew safety with scientific objectives. Strengthens communication, shared mission awareness, and coordination between astronauts and ground-control systems.

Selected Regions: Features 10 diverse Martian regions, including Jezero Crater, Gale Crater and Mount Sharp, Valles Marineris, and Olympus Mons. These regions represent Mars's geological and environmental diversity, including evidence of ancient water, mineral diversity, ice formations, and volcanic activity.
